ohm.title: OpenHistoricalMap
ohm.description: The world's most comprehensive open platform for historical maps.
ohm.challenge: Before our intervention, OHM struggled with scaling their infrastructure to handle millions of historical vector tiles and concurrent edits. The system was prone to downtime during high-traffic events, and the rendering pipeline was inefficient for time-based data queries.
ohm.solution: We re-architected the entire stack using Kubernetes, implementing a custom vector tile generation pipeline optimized for historical data with time-dimension support. We migrated the database to a high-availability PostGIS cluster and implemented advanced caching strategies using Varnish and CDN.

results.3: Seamless integration with JOSM and iD editor

palestine.title: Palestine Open Maps
palestine.description: A platform for visualizing and exploring historical maps of Palestine.
palestine.challenge: The project needed a way to digitize, georeference, and serve thousands of historical paper maps from the Mandate era, making them accessible and searchable alongside modern data. Ensuring data sovereignty and performance for a globally distributed audience was critical.
palestine.solution: We developed a custom map viewer using MapLibre GL JS that allows users to overlay historical maps with adjustable opacity. We built a robust backend for managing georeferenced assets and implemented a vector tile pipeline to serve complex historical boundaries efficiently.

results.1: Digitized over 200 sheets of historical maps

sandbox.title: SandBox OSM-US
sandbox.description: A safe environment for training new OpenStreetMap mappers.
sandbox.challenge: OpenStreetMap US needed a way to train new mappers without risking vandalism or poor-quality edits to the main OSM database. They required an isolated replica of the OSM stack that could be easily reset.
sandbox.solution: We deployed a complete, containerized replica of the OpenStreetMap API (Rails port) and rendering stack. We implemented automated scripts to reset the database periodically, providing a clean slate for each training cohort. The system runs on a cost-effective cloud infrastructure managed via Terraform.

results.3: Identical experience to main OSM website

kendall.title: Kendall County GIS
kendall.description: Modernizing local government GIS data access.
kendall.challenge: Kendall County's GIS data was locked in proprietary formats and accessible only through slow, legacy desktop viewers. Citizens and businesses struggled to access property information and zoning data.
kendall.solution: We migrated their core datasets from proprietary geodatabases to PostGIS. We built a modern, responsive web portal using React and MapLibre that allows citizens to search parcels, view zoning, and print reports. The system is hosted on a secure, scalable cloud environment.

results.1: Public access to parcel data increased by 300%
results.3: Significant cost savings on software licensing
